mechanism: Verapamil inhibits CYP3A4, which metabolizes eplerenone, leading to increased eplerenone concentrations and hyperkalemia risk; both agents also have additive effects on cardiac conduction and blood pressure.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; consider dose reduction of eplerenone; monitor for bradycardia and AV block; alternative calcium channel blocker (diltiazem also inhibits CYP3A4 but less potently; amlodipine does not) may be considered.
